systems.platform: data exchange with security servers; national layer run on Galaxy Backbone infrastructure
systems.owner: Galaxy Backbone Limited as operator, under standards of the National Information Technology Development Agency
systems.tiers: draft design in three layers: national (federal agencies), sub-national (operated by state governments, scope 'state-level agencies and local government areas', required to connect to the national exchange) and sectoral

note: A draft technical standard (version 1.3, 17 March 2025) for a national data exchange: it lists local government bodies among its audience and puts local government areas in the scope of a state-run sub-national layer. A design on paper, stating no connection at any local government office, so no fact. The exchange is a data-sharing layer that fits none of the study's classes; its class is left empty for the parent.
